# Support

## Bugs

Use the bug report template in the relevant repository and include enough information to reproduce the problem.

## Language and tooling questions

For questions about Raz syntax, compiler behavior, package tooling, or project direction, use GitHub Discussions when enabled on the relevant repository.

## Feature requests

Use the feature request template. Describe the problem first, then the proposed language or tooling change.

## Security

Do not use public issues for vulnerabilities. Follow the process in `SECURITY.md`.
